proves.claim: A green gate receipt posted through boardJobQueueCall that records a sprint item's submission calls the screen starter handed in by provideScreenStart once, with the item, its commit and the trunk tip.

api.gate.screen-start.sprint-submit-star.why: Without this test nothing starts the screen a submitted sprint item lands on, and sprint waits for a verdict like steady.

proves.claim: A steady or strict item, or a board handed no screen starter, starts no screen, and the receipt apply prepares the same board statements as a steady one.

api.gate.screen-start.steady-unchanged.why: Sprint wiring must change nothing for steady items and add no board call.
